title: A Phone Call from the Library

dialogue.speaker: Rustam
dialogue.text: Hey Kamila, where are you? I'm standing outside the canteen. Are you coming?

dialogue.speaker: Kamila
dialogue.text: Hi Rustam! Sorry, I can't come right now. I'm still in the library. I'm helping someone.

dialogue.speaker: Rustam
dialogue.text: Who are you helping? Is everything okay?

dialogue.speaker: Kamila
dialogue.text: Yes, fine — there's a first-year student here. She's looking for books for her history assignment. I'm searching the catalogue for her.

dialogue.speaker: Rustam
dialogue.text: Oh right, your library volunteer shift. How long are you going to be? Zhibek is sitting here with me. We're both getting hungry.

dialogue.speaker: Kamila
dialogue.text: I'm nearly done — five or ten minutes. Is Amir coming too?

dialogue.speaker: Rustam
dialogue.text: No, Amir is still in the lab. He's fixing some code. He says he's not eating until the bug is solved.

dialogue.speaker: Kamila
dialogue.text: Typical! What is Zhibek doing right now?

dialogue.speaker: Rustam
dialogue.text: She's scrolling through her phone. She's looking at the tournament draw for next weekend.

dialogue.speaker: Kamila
dialogue.text: Are you two sitting inside or outside?

dialogue.speaker: Rustam
dialogue.text: We're sitting outside. The weather is nice. Someone next to us is playing music — it's quite loud actually.

dialogue.speaker: Kamila
dialogue.text: Okay, I'm just printing out the book list for this student now. I'll meet you in seven minutes.

dialogue.speaker: Rustam
dialogue.text: Great. I'm ordering food now. What do you want?

dialogue.speaker: Kamila
dialogue.text: Soup and bread, please. Oh, and tell Zhibek I'm not looking at the tournament draw until after I eat!

dialogue.speaker: Rustam
dialogue.text: Ha! She's already sending you a voice message about it. Your phone is probably buzzing.

dialogue.speaker: Kamila
dialogue.text: I'm ignoring it. See you in seven minutes!

questions.hint: "I'm just printing out the book list for this student now."

questions.text: "She's scrolling through her phone." What tense is this?
questions.hint: is/are + verb-ing = Present Continuous. "She is scrolling" = happening right now at this moment.

questions.text: "Amir ___ his code right now." Complete with Present Continuous.
questions.hint: Present Continuous: subject + is/am/are + verb-ing. "He is fixing" → short form: "He's fixing".

questions.text: "Are you coming?" — What is the correct short answer if the answer is no?
questions.hint: Present Continuous question "Are you...?" → short answer: "No, I'm not." (never "No, I don't.")

questions.text: "What does Zhibek do right now?" is the correct way to ask about a current action.
questions.hint: For actions happening RIGHT NOW, use Present Continuous: "What IS Zhibek DOING right now?" ✅

questions.text: Which sentence describes what is happening NOW?
questions.hint: "is helping" = Present Continuous = happening RIGHT NOW at this moment.
They = plural → are sitting. Present Continuous: are + verb-ing.
Negative Present Continuous: I'm not + verb-ing. "I'm not ignoring it." ✅
sit ends in CVC (consonant-vowel-consonant) → double final consonant + ing: sit → sitting. (run→running, swim→swimming)
